More follow-ups from the re-review of f28497cae (APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS):
5. Context equality is O(context) per link equals/hashCode, so resolve costs links x mentions (rule 9). Cache a content digest of ReferentContext in a lazy val and compare digests (also moves toward rule 10 content addressing).
6. Fallback is conservative: settled class {x,y}, open class {p,q}, direct distinct x-p gives relation(y,p) = Unknown although y differs from p follows from y = x. Fails closed; derive it or document it.
7. Track coverage is a caller-supplied map keyed by TrackId, not bound to a stream and not checked against the mentions' Track anchors.
8. Add mutants for guards that have tests but no mutant: ContinuousTrack visual-only, extents.isEmpty, SameMention, DifferentNames same/missing, recall support, DuplicateMention, unknown hint mention, deixis "another" and "nobody", SimultaneousTracks "both need a track" and "visual only".
9. ReferentRelation names (Same/Open) vs ADR 0024 wording (Resolved/Open): record the naming in an ADR 0024 line (SD5).
